description: Daily job aggregation system that pulls from 3+ RSS sources, normalizes jobs to standard schema, deduplicates, filters by recency, and stores in Notion. Perfect for building a centralized job database.
purpose: Aggregate remote jobs from multiple sources, deduplicate, and maintain a single source of truth in Notion
features: 3 independent RSS feed sources (RemoteOK, We Work Remotely, Remotive)
Parallel job fetching from all sources
Duplicate detection via existing job IDs
Error handling for failed RSS feeds

workflow_stages.stage_2_config: Global Config node loads placeholders (edit here for custom settings)
workflow_stages.stage_3_collection: 3 RSS sources fetch jobs in parallel (RemoteOK, We Work Remotely, Remotive)
workflow_stages.stage_4_tagging: Each source tagged with origin (RemoteOK, WeWorkRemotely, Remotive)
workflow_stages.stage_5_merge: Merge All Sources — appends all 100+ items into single stream
workflow_stages.stage_6_normalize: Normalize Jobs — converts each source's schema to standard job object
workflow_stages.stage_7_store: Store Job in Notion — writes normalized jobs to Notion database
workflow_stages.stage_8_dedupe_check: Get Existing Job IDs — fetches all previously stored job IDs from Notion
workflow_stages.stage_9_merge_for_dedupe: Merge For Dedupe — combines current jobs with existing IDs for comparison
workflow_stages.stage_10_filter: Recency and Duplicate Filter — removes old/duplicate jobs, keeps only new ones

deduplication_logic.step_1: Fetch all existing job IDs from Notion database
deduplication_logic.step_2: Compare current batch against existing IDs
deduplication_logic.step_3: Flag duplicates (same job from same source)
deduplication_logic.step_4: Keep cross-source duplicates if score improved (e.g., different company posting same role)
deduplication_logic.step_5: Filter out jobs older than N days (recency filter)
deduplication_logic.step_6: Store only new, non-duplicate, recent jobs to Notion
